section_title: Universal Life Insurance - a tailor-made insurance plan
summary_en: FLEXI-ULife Prime Saver is presented as a universal life insurance plan with flexible coverage, preferential premium rates, premium flexibility, monthly compound interest, and flexible cash withdrawal.
summary_zh: FLEXI-ULife Prime Saver 是一份万用寿险计划，资料册强调其保障额可灵活调整、加保可按最初投保年龄计算保费率、可在有现金价值时暂停缴费，并支持现金提取。
source_text: Universal Life Insurance - a tailor-made insurance plan. Simply adjust the original Policy to increase the sum insured. Premium rate for new coverage will be based on the insured's age when the Policy was first issued. Allows you to skip payments if the Policy has accumulated a cash value, without any loan interest.
important_caveats: The brochure states that the information is for reference only and users should refer to the policy document for detailed benefit coverage.

summary_en: The policy allows the Basic Sum Insured to be increased without applying for a new policy. It may also be decreased if necessary, but a surrender charge may be deducted from Account Value.
summary_zh: 保单可在同一保单内增加基本保障额，无须另购新单；如有需要亦可调低基本保障额，但可能需要从账户价值中扣除适用的退保费用。
source_text: Simply adjust the original Policy to increase the Basic Sum Insured. There's no need to apply for a new Policy, thus saving additional policy charges. You may also decrease the Basic Sum Insured if necessary. However, this may be subject to the deduction of a surrender charge from the Account Value.
important_caveats: Decreasing the Basic Sum Insured may trigger a surrender charge deducted from Account Value.

summary_en: The plan offers Level Benefit, Increasing Benefit, Increasing Benefit Plus, and Incremental Benefit. Their death benefit formulas differ by Account Value and Basic Sum Insured.
summary_zh: 计划提供固定寿险保障、递增寿险保障、特级递增寿险保障和渐进寿险保障。不同选择的身故保障计算方式不同，涉及账户价值和基本保障额。
source_text: Level Benefit: Account Value OR Basic Sum Insured, whichever is higher. Increasing Benefit / Increasing Benefit Plus: Account Value + Basic Sum Insured. Incremental Benefit: Account Value OR Basic Sum Insured + 50% of Account Value, whichever is higher.
important_caveats: Some death benefit formulas are net of withdrawals made in the 12-month period before death, according to the notes.

summary_en: Premiums are credited to Account Value after applicable charges. The brochure states a current assumed base crediting interest rate of 4% p.a. and retrospective additional interest of 0.25% p.a.; these current assumed rates are not guaranteed and may change.
summary_zh: 供款扣除适用费用后会存入账户价值。资料册列出现时假设基本派息率为每年 4%，现时假设额外利息率为每年 0.25%；这些是假设值，并非保证，日后可能更改。
source_text: Current assumed base crediting interest rate: 4% p.a. Current assumed retrospective additional interest rate: 0.25% p.a. The current assumed rates are quoted as of the print date of this brochure in January 2022, and are not guaranteed. They are subject to change.
important_caveats: The 4% and 0.25% rates are current assumed rates, not guaranteed rates.
They are subject to change.

summary_en: When a policy has been in force for 15 years or more, Account Value including credited interest and Extra Bonus is guaranteed to have accumulated to at least an amount as if the interest rate credited had been 2.5% p.a.
summary_zh: 保单生效满 15 年或以上时，账户价值（包括已拨入保单的利息及额外回报）保证不会少于按每年 2.5% 派息率累积的金额。
source_text: When a Policy has been in force for 15 years or more, the total interest and Extra Bonus credited to the Policy will be such that the Account Value is guaranteed to have accumulated to at least an amount as if the interest rate credited had been 2.5% p.a.
important_caveats: The guarantee applies only when the policy has been in force for 15 years or more.

summary_en: Extra Bonus is credited at the end of the 15th policy year and every 5 years thereafter. The current assumed Extra Bonus rate is 2.75% for policy years 15, 20, and 25, and 5.5% for year 30 and every 5 years thereafter.
summary_zh: 额外回报于第 15 个保单周年日及其后每 5 年派发。现时假设额外回报率在第 15、20、25 年为 2.75%，第 30 年及其后每 5 年为 5.5%。
source_text: Extra Bonus will be credited to the Policy at the end of the 15th policy year and for every 5 years thereafter. The current assumed Extra Bonus rate: 15th, 20th, 25th year 2.75%; the 30th year and every 5 years thereafter 5.5%.
important_caveats: The figures shown in the brochure example are illustrative and not actual.
The applicable Extra Bonus rate at distribution applies.

summary_en: The policy supports increasing regular or unscheduled premiums, automatic periodic withdrawals, partial cash value withdrawals, and skipping premium payments if sufficient Cash Value has accumulated.
summary_zh: 保单支持增加定期或非定期供款、定期提款、部分提取现金价值，以及在累积足够现金价值时暂停缴付保费。
source_text: You can increase regular or unscheduled premiums at any time. When your Policy has accumulated a Cash Value, you can exercise the automatic periodic withdrawal option. You can withdraw a portion of the Cash Value at any time. When your Policy has accumulated a Cash Value, you may skip premium payments to cope with emergencies.
important_caveats: Cash withdrawal, reducing premium amount, or skipping premium payments will affect Cash Value accumulation.
Monthly charges remain deductible.
If Cash Value is not sufficient to cover monthly charges, the Policy will lapse with zero value.

section_title: Extra Protections for Total Peace of Mind
summary_en: The plan includes unemployment protection with a Special Grace Period of up to 365 days, Terminal Illness Benefit, and optional supplementary benefits such as Waiver of Premium, Critical Illness Benefit, and Accident Benefit.
summary_zh: 计划包括失业保障，可享有最长 365 日特惠宽限期；另有末期病症保障，以及豁免保费、严重疾病保障、意外保障等附加保障。
source_text: Unemployment Protection: Should the Policy Owner be made redundant, there is an option which allows suspension of premium payments for 365 days. Terminal Illness Benefit: a sum will be paid, which is the Death Benefit of the basic plan and supplementary benefits if any. Supplementary benefits include Waiver of Premium Benefit, Critical Illness Benefit, Accident Benefit, etc.
important_caveats: Unemployment Protection is only applicable to the Basic Plan.
Upon payment of Terminal Illness Benefit, related policies and supplementary benefits will automatically terminate.

summary_en: The Guaranteed Insurability Option can be exercised one year after the Effective Date of Coverage and terminates after the policy anniversary following the insured's 51st birthday. Each increase is capped and the option can be exercised at most twice.
summary_zh: 保证可保权益只适用于保障生效日期一年后行使，并至受保人 51 岁后的保单周年日终止。每次增加额有限制，最多只可行使两次。
source_text: The Guaranteed Insurability Option can be exercised one year after the Effective Date of Coverage, and will terminate on the policy anniversary following the Insured's 51st birthday. For each time, the increase shall not exceed 25% of the Basic Sum Insured before exercising the option, the aggregate increase shall not exceed US$50,000/HK$400,000/MOP400,000, and this option can at most be exercised twice.
important_caveats: Please refer to the policy document for relevant terms and conditions.

summary_en: Cash withdrawals, reducing premiums, or skipping premiums reduce Cash Value accumulation while monthly charges continue. If Cash Value cannot cover monthly charges and no premium is paid before the 31-day grace period ends, the policy lapses with zero value.
summary_zh: 提取现金、减低或暂停缴付保费会减少现金价值累积，但每月费用仍会扣除。如现金价值不足以支付每月费用，并且 31 天宽限期届满前仍未缴付保费，保单会终止且没有任何价值。
source_text: Cash withdrawals, reducing the premium amount, or skipping premium payments will reduce the accumulation of the Cash Value, while the monthly charges are still deductible. If the Cash Value is not sufficient to cover the monthly charges and no premiums are made before the end of the 31-day Grace Period, the Policy will lapse with zero value.
important_caveats: This is a key lapse risk and should be mentioned when discussing withdrawals or skipped premiums.

summary_en: The product is intended to be held long term. If the policy is terminated early, the Cash Value received may be considerably less than total premiums paid.
summary_zh: 本产品是为长期持有而设。如提早终止保单，获得的现金价值可能远低于已缴保费总额。
source_text: The product is intended to be held in the long-term. Should you terminate the Policy early, you may receive a Cash Value considerably less than the total premiums paid.
important_caveats: This should be cited when discussing surrender or early termination.

summary_en: If the insured commits suicide within one year from the Policy Date, total liability is limited to Account Value on the date of death plus Cost of Insurance deducted, without interest.
summary_zh: 如受保人在保单日期起计一年内自杀，无论是否神智清醒，公司责任限于退还身故当日的账户价值加已扣除的保险成本，不包括利息。
source_text: If the Insured commits suicide, whether sane or insane, within one year from the Policy Date, our total liability shall be limited to the aggregate of the Account Value on the date of death of the Insured and the Cost of Insurance deducted, without any interest.
important_caveats: Terminal Illness Benefit also has specific exclusions listed in the brochure.

section_title: FLEXI-ULife Prime Saver - at a glance
summary_en: The at-a-glance table lists benefits including current assumed base crediting interest rate of 4.0% p.a., retrospective additional interest of 0.25% p.a., Extra Bonus schedule, guaranteed interest, death benefit options, Guaranteed Insurability Option, Unemployment Benefit, Terminal Illness Benefit, and supplementary benefits.
summary_zh: 一览表列出主要利益，包括现时假设基本派息率 4.0%、额外利息 0.25%、额外回报派发安排、利息保证、身故保障选择、保证可保权益、失业保障、末期病症保障及附加保障。
source_text: Current assumed base crediting interest rate is 4.0% p.a. Retrospective additional interest current assumed rate is 0.25% p.a. Extra Bonus is credited at the end of the 15th policy year and every 5 years thereafter. Death Benefit Options: Level Benefit / Increasing Benefit / Increasing Benefit Plus / Incremental Benefit.
important_caveats: Current assumed rates are not the same as guaranteed rates.

summary_en: Premium Expense Charge is 10% of premium payments in policy years 1-3, 7% in years 4-9, and 5% thereafter. Cost of Insurance and Administrative Charge are charged monthly and depend on policy and insured factors.
summary_zh: 保费行政费用在第 1 至 3 个保单年度为所缴保费的 10%，第 4 至 9 年为 7%，其后为 5%。保险成本及一般行政费用按月收取，并取决于受保人和保单因素。
source_text: Premium Expense Charge: 10% of premium payments made in policy years 1 to 3 inclusive, 7% in policy years 4 to 9 inclusive and 5% thereafter. Cost of Insurance is charged monthly. Administrative Charge is charged monthly.
important_caveats: The current scale of fees and charges is not guaranteed and may change with one-month prior written notice.

summary_en: Issue Age is 0-75, except Increasing Benefit Plus where Issue Age is 0-55. Benefit Term and Premium Payment Term are to age 100.
summary_zh: 投保年龄为 0 至 75 岁；如选择特级递增寿险保障，投保年龄为 0 至 55 岁。保障年期及缴付保费年期均至 100 岁。
source_text: Issue Age: Age 0-75. For Increasing Benefit Plus, Issue Age is 0-55. Benefit Term: To Age 100. Premium Payment Term: To Age 100.
important_caveats: Eligibility may be subject to underwriting and exact policy terms.
